hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(printf %s "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .file_path // .path // empty" 2>/dev/null); case "$FILE" in *.go) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; gofumpt -w "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; OUT=$(golangci-lint run --fast-only --fix "$FILE" 2>&1); RC=$?; if [ $RC -ne 0 ] && printf %s "$OUT" | grep -qE ":[0-9]+:[0-9]+:"; then jq -nc --arg ctx "golangci-lint reports unresolved issues in $FILE after --fix:\n$OUT" '\''{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:$ctx}}'\''; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(printf %s "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .file_path // .path // empty" 2>/dev/null); case "$FILE" in *.golangci.yml|*.golangci.yaml|*cspell.json|*.markdownlint.json) printf "BLOCKED: リンター設定ファイルは直接編集禁止。コードを修正してリンターエラーを解消してください。\n" >&2; exit 2;; esac; if printf %s "$FILE" | grep -qE '\''(^|/)\.env($|\.)|(^|/)\.envrc$|\.(key|pem|p12|pfx)$|(^|/)kubeconfig$|(^|/)id_(rsa|ed25519|ecdsa|dsa)([^/]*)?$|(^|/)credentials\.json$|(^|/)service-account\.json$|(^|/)\.aws/credentials$'\''; then printf "BLOCKED: secret/credential file edits forbidden (%s)\n" "$FILE" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(printf %s "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty" 2>/dev/null); if printf %s "$CMD" | grep -qE '''rm[[:space:]]+(-[rf]{1,2}|-r[[:space:]]+-f|-f[[:space:]]+-r)([[:space:]]+--)?[[:space:]]+(/|~|\*)'''; then printf "BLOCKED: destructive rm at filesystem root
" >&2; exit 2; fi; if printf %s "$CMD" | grep -qE '''git[[:space:]]+push.*((--force[[:space:]]|--force$|-f[[:space:]]|-f$).*(main|master)([[:space:]]|$)|(main|master)[[:space:]].*(--force[[:space:]]|--force$|-f[[:space:]]|-f$))'''; then printf "BLOCKED: force-push to main/master
" >&2; exit 2; fi; if printf %s "$CMD" | grep -qE '''(^|[[:space:]])--no-verify([[:space:]]|$)'''; then printf "BLOCKED: git hook bypass flag forbidden
" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$ROOT" ] || ! cd "$ROOT" 2>/dev/null; then exit 0; fi; OUT=$( { go build ./... && go test ./... -short -count=1; } 2>&1); RC=$?; OUT="${OUT:0:4000}"; if [ $RC -ne 0 ]; then jq -nc --arg ctx "Stop hook: build/test failed (truncated to 4KB):\n$OUT" '\''{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"Stop",additionalContext:$ctx}}'\''; fi; exit 0'
